SKETCHMAN · CHARACTER RIG LAB v3

Reusable 18-joint hierarchy. Original APK run-frame pixels are separated into independently transformable cutout layers and linked to bones. Drag the sliders to test their motion. The rig now starts from run-frame-specific joint coordinates rather than a neutral standing pose. Drag markers to correct alignment against the actual sprite. Layer boundaries still need cleanup.

Drag joint dots directly onto the matching anatomical landmarks in the original sprite. Joint placement is saved in this browser. Turn on the sprite reference to calibrate.

Cutout prototype, not yet production-ready: automatic segmentation can create seams and the original animation poses still need manual cleanup. No changes to the playable game or its collisions.
